messages:
sam (Design): Dropping a new prototype for the Alerting preview — focuses: compact example alert card, channel pills, and the 'snooze' vs 'silence' wording. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/alert-preview-proto. Can folks skim for copy + a11y?

ivy (PM): Thanks Sam. Quick product note: customers often ask how long a silence lasts when they click it. Can we show a default duration in the preview and let them change it in the modal?

diego (Frontend): Yep we can show `Silenced: 1h` inline. Implementation question: should that be live text or a tooltip? Live text is better for screen readers.

maya (Accessibility): Live text is good. Make sure it's announced when state changes via a polite live region: `role=status` and message like 'PagerDuty silenced for 1 hour'. Also ensure the control has `aria-pressed` or `aria-checked` depending on toggle semantics.

sam (Design): About labels 12 I mocked the button as 'Snooze' in one version and 'Silence' in another. Which is clearer?

ivy (PM): 'Snooze' sounds friendly but ambiguous; 'Silence' is clear for SREs. Maybe surface 'Snooze' in consumer-facing product and 'Silence' in admin/oncall docs. But single UI should avoid split language. Prefer 'Silence' + supportive microcopy.

frank (SRE): Strong +1 for 'Silence'. In runbooks we already use 'Silence' and monitoring tooling uses the same term. Consistency matters when on-call folks look for quick action.

maya (Accessibility): Also prefer 'Silence' since screen readers can parse it as an action. If we use 'Snooze' some SR users might not immediately map it to notifications.

diego (Frontend): Noted. We'll use `button` with `aria-pressed` and add `aria-live` announcement on toggle. Also will support keyboard shortcut `S` to toggle silence when pill is focused.

sam (Design): Overflow behavior: current mock collapses extra channels into `+N`. Proposal: show prioritized channels (pager, slack, email) first, then overflow. And the overflow menu should be a keyboard-accessible popover.

frank (SRE): Prioritization is important. Also ask that the preview visually mark channels that will escalate (e.g., pager has a red stripe).

maya (Accessibility): For the popover use role `dialog` with `aria-modal=false` if it's a transient menu. Focus trap only if it's a full modal. Ensure Esc closes and focus returns to the pill.

sam (Design): Copy for overflow pill tooltip: 'Show 3 more channels'. Keep tooltips short.

diego (Frontend): Minor CSS note: the overflow pill needs same focus ring and at least 3px contrast stroke. Current figma has 2px light border.

maya (Accessibility): Contrast numbers: pills on gray-100 have 3.1:1 when normal. For interactive controls we aim >=3:1 per WCAG 2AA for UI components, but text inside needs 4.5:1 if small. Make pill text 14px semibold to reach 4.5:1.

sam (Design): Good call. I'll adjust token values. Also proposing a subtle divider in the preview between channels and the example alert content for clearer scanning.

ivy (PM): Can the preview show a mock alert title and timestamp? Helps product teams visualize. E.g., 'Latency spike — 2m ago'.

sam (Design): Yes — will add a tiny example card: title, brief metric line, and channel row.

diego (Frontend): Example JSON we can consume for preview (for docs):

```json
{
  "id": "alert-001",
  "title": "Latency spike — api/redwood",
  "when": "2m ago",
  "channels": [
    {"id":"pager","label":"PagerDuty","priority":1,"silenced":false},
    {"id":"slack","label":"#alerts-prod","priority":2,"silenced":false},
    {"id":"email","label":"oncall@example.com","priority":3,"silenced":true},
    {"id":"webhook","label":"Webhook","priority":4,"silenced":false}
  ]
}
```

frank (SRE): That payload looks good. For priority we treat lower number as higher priority. We'll want an API flag later to persist per-alert overrides.

maya (Accessibility): One more a11y nit: ensure the example alert card is reachable via keyboard skip link 'Jump to preview' for long pages. And semantic heading for the preview like `h3` with text 'Who will be notified'.

sam (Design): Action items: 1) Update copy to 'Silence' + inline duration. 2) Tweak pill typography/contrast. 3) Prioritize channels in preview + overflow behavior. 4) Diego to add aria-live announcements and `aria-pressed`. 5) Maya to review once figma updated. Target: Wednesday EOD.

ivy (PM): Thanks team. If no objections I'll merge these into the spec doc and flag the SRE runbook language alignment work.
